name: Start / wake (ignition)
synonyms: ignition|start|wake|power on|won't start|no start|does not wake|key
description: 12 V start switch input to the BCM, wake request to the VCU, contactor close command to the HV junction box.

name: 12 V supply
description: DC-DC converter charges the 12 V battery; the fuse box distributes 12 V to modules.

name: HV traction
description: Pack to junction box to front and rear inverters and drive units.

name: Charging
description: Charge connector through the charge harness to the OBC and junction box; BMS supervises the pack.

name: Front lighting
description: BCM drives both headlamps through the front LV harness.

name: Rear lighting
description: BCM drives both tail lamps through the rear LV harness.

name: Steering
description: Fuse box supplies EPAS; VCU commands it over CAN; steering-wheel controls talk to the BCM over LIN.

name: Door locks and windows
description: BCM to each door module through the cabin harness.

name: Seat heating and airbags
description: Fuse box to front seats through the cabin harness.

name: Thermal
description: HV supply to the thermal module; VCU control over CAN.

name: Infotainment and cluster
description: 12 V to head unit and cluster; CAN between them and the VCU.

name: Vehicle CAN bus
description: Twisted pair between VCU, BCM, BMS, inverters, OBC, EPAS, thermal and displays.
